label: Bible Study
prompt: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the _____, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
verse: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.
note: The new Jerusalem needs no sun or moon — God's glory is the light.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful _____: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
verse: His lord said unto him, Well done, thou good and faithful servant: thou hast been faithful over a few things, I will make thee ruler over many things: enter thou into the joy of thy lord.
note: The words every worker longs to hear: 'Well done' — and faithfulness in a few things leads into the master's joy.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his _____ drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
verse: And the ass saw the angel of the LORD standing in the way, and his sword drawn in his hand: and the ass turned aside out of the way, and went into the field: and Balaam smote the ass, to turn her into the way.
note: The donkey saw the angel with the drawn sword before the prophet did — and got beaten for being right.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But there is a spirit in man: and the _____ of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
verse: But there is a spirit in man: and the inspiration of the Almighty giveth them understanding.
note: Young Elihu finally speaks: wisdom isn't just a matter of age — it's God-given understanding.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an _____ evil, full of deadly poison.
verse: But the tongue can no man tame; it is an unruly evil, full of deadly poison.
note: Mankind has tamed beasts, birds, and sea creatures (verse 7), but the tongue 'can no man tame.'
